title: Gift webhook idempotency hardening
description: Prevent duplicate gift inserts and duplicate state transitions on Stripe retries by enforcing uniqueness and safe replay handling. Acceptance: Replaying same webhook event does not change totals; replay test passes on local fixture.

title: Gift state transition guardrails
description: Enforce valid lifecycle transitions only and block invalid transitions with structured errors. Acceptance: Invalid transitions are blocked; admin override leaves traceable audit row.

title: Admin integrity card data completeness
description: Remove empty integrity states and always return deterministic diagnostics structure. Acceptance: Integrity section always renders with deterministic structure; empty-db case is informative and non-breaking.

title: Funnel instrumentation baseline
description: Capture first-touch to first-gift event chain with normalized payload contracts. Acceptance: Sample session shows expected event sequence; admin/growth endpoint reads counts by 7-day window.

title: Checkout validation hard stop (email + inputs)
description: Prevent avoidable Stripe 400 errors by validating email and required checkout fields before API call. Acceptance: Invalid email never reaches checkout endpoint; user sees actionable inline error.

title: Mobile CTA crowding pass
description: Improve small-screen action layout and tap ergonomics for core action clusters. Acceptance: No overlapping/cutoff labels on mobile widths; tap targets meet minimum size expectation.

title: Admin crash guard pass
description: Add resilient loading and error boundaries per admin tab and prevent hook-order regressions. Acceptance: No nominal-path tab crashes; error states recover via refresh/retry.

title: Baseline smoke script update
description: Extend smoke routine to cover gift checkout, webhook processing, memory linkage, and admin integrity endpoint. Acceptance: Single command verifies core gift pipeline basics before release.

title: Checkout error taxonomy and instrumentation
description: Make checkout failures measurable by normalizing reason codes and emitting checkout_error events. Acceptance: Every checkout failure has a reason code; admin shows ranked error causes for last 7 days.

title: Checkout mobile layout optimization
description: Reduce mobile drop-off by improving spacing, stacking, and CTA visibility. Acceptance: No clipped content or overlapping controls on tested widths; mobile completion improves from Week 1 baseline.

title: Fee breakdown readability pass
description: Improve confidence and comprehension in pricing summary with clearer label hierarchy. Acceptance: Users identify net amount quickly in usability pass; no terminology mismatch between checkout and admin.

title: Projection copy and assumption consistency audit
description: Ensure scenario-based return language and assumption controls are consistent across surfaces. Acceptance: No fixed-return language remains; assumption help text matches across pages.

title: CTA hierarchy refactor on fund/dashboard mobile
description: De-crowd action controls by grouping secondary actions and preserving primary action clarity. Acceptance: Primary action is always obvious; tap misfires reduced in QA walkthrough.

title: UX copy standardization (errors + confirmations)
description: Standardize confirmation and error language and remove technical backend phrasing. Acceptance: Copy review passes for touched flows; no raw backend error strings shown to end users.

title: Stripe checkout preflight endpoint
description: Add preflight validation to prevent avoidable checkout session failures. Acceptance: Invalid requests fail preflight instead of checkout creation; frontend shows specific remediation message.

title: Baseline conversion dashboard and report
description: Publish weekly conversion scorecard with starts, completes, failure reasons, and device split. Acceptance: Week 2 scorecard published and repeatable; rates tie back to tracked events.

title: Gift to Memory linkage contract tests
description: Guarantee successful gifts always create or attach a memory entry. Acceptance: Contract test passes for gift success path; no new Gifts Missing Memory in 7-day diagnostics.

title: Memory Book media rendering hardening
description: Ensure text, image, and video entries render predictably on web and mobile. Acceptance: No media rendering crashes; fallback states shown for invalid media URLs.

title: Thank-you workflow status model
description: Implement explicit thank-you lifecycle states and retry handling. Acceptance: Status visible in UI and admin diagnostics; failed sends are retryable.

title: Gift success page data accuracy pass
description: Ensure confirmation reflects real amount and execution model. Acceptance: No $0 confirmations for paid gifts; stock-pick gifts show chosen ticker where applicable.

title: Memory Book cross-linking from gifts
description: Add direct navigation from gift rows to related memory entries. Acceptance: Gift row includes View memory when linked; link opens correct memory entry.

title: Thank-you CTA placement optimization
description: Improve thank-you completion by better CTA positioning. Acceptance: CTA present in memory and gift detail contexts; thank-you action rate improves from Week 2 baseline.

title: Admin diagnostics for thank-you gaps
description: Surface missing thank-you records with drill-down and export. Acceptance: Metric links to affected gifts; drill-down supports CSV export.

title: Week 3 loop scorecard
description: Publish weekly loop health report for memory and thank-you completion. Acceptance: Weekly report includes trend and deltas; shared in Friday cadence.

title: Admin KPI card click-through filters
description: Enable KPI cards to open filtered datasets that explain displayed metrics. Acceptance: Every top KPI card opens filtered records matching displayed metric.

title: User detail panel expansion
description: Add complete user-level admin detail context including funds, gifts, subscription, and transactions. Acceptance: User detail includes funds gifts subscription and recent transactions.

title: Fund detail panel expansion
description: Add complete fund-level admin detail context including holdings and gift timeline. Acceptance: Fund detail includes holdings mix gifts timeline and pending vs invested split.

title: Gifter profile detail page
description: Add deep gifter profile with lifetime contribution behavior. Acceptance: Gifter detail shows lifetime gross/net gift frequency and recipient breakdown.

title: CSV parity across tabs
description: Standardize CSV exports across all major admin tabs. Acceptance: Users Funds Assets Gifters Gifts Transactions all export with consistent columns.

title: Admin action safeguards + audit
description: Add confirmation and audit logging for sensitive admin actions. Acceptance: Destructive actions require confirmation and generate audit entries.

title: Config tab safe editing UX
description: Improve config editing flow with validation and explicit errors. Acceptance: Universe and strategy edits validate before save and show clear errors.

title: Week 4 admin ops scorecard
description: Publish weekly admin operations quality report. Acceptance: Report includes tab reliability export usage and action audit volume.

title: Attribution source normalization
description: Normalize source and channel tracking on top acquisition events. Acceptance: Top acquisition events include stable source/channel fields.

title: Founder content cadence tracker
description: Track founder content output and downstream traffic impact. Acceptance: Weekly dashboard shows founder posts and downstream traffic.

title: Creator pilot intake workflow
description: Create structured creator campaign intake and status workflow. Acceptance: Creator roster status and campaign links tracked in one place.

title: Channel to first-gift conversion report
description: Report conversion by source channel from visit to first gift. Acceptance: Report shows conversion by channel from visit to first gift.

title: Share-link UTM propagation
description: Preserve and propagate UTM params into conversion events. Acceptance: UTM params are preserved and tied to conversion events.

title: Gift page referral context module
description: Display optional campaign source context on gift page. Acceptance: Gift page can display optional campaign/source context cleanly.

title: Weekly growth experiment template
description: Standardize hypothesis and experiment logging process. Acceptance: Team uses one standardized template for hypotheses and outcomes.

title: Week 5 channel scorecard
description: Publish weekly channel scorecard with spend and outcome metrics. Acceptance: Scorecard lists top channels with spend conversion and AFRG impact.

title: Host re-engagement reminder engine
description: Implement reminder triggers for hosts before key gifting windows. Acceptance: Hosts receive targeted reminders before key event windows.

title: Repeat gifter prompt flow
description: Add contextual one-tap flow for prior gifters to gift again. Acceptance: Prior gifters are prompted contextually with one-tap repeat flow.

title: 12-week cohort retention table
description: Populate retention table with week and fund-type filters. Acceptance: Cohort table is populated and filterable by week and fund type.

title: AFRG cohort trend panel
description: Add AFRG trend visualization by cohort start week. Acceptance: AFRG trend visible by cohort start week with stable definitions.

title: Time-to-first-gift diagnostics
description: Show median and P75 first-gift timing with week-over-week movement. Acceptance: Median and P75 time-to-first-gift shown with weekly movement.

title: In-app milestone nudges
description: Introduce milestone prompts to support retention and re-engagement. Acceptance: Milestone prompts appear at sensible thresholds and can be dismissed.

title: Repeat gifter rate KPI card
description: Add repeat gifter KPI card with detail drill-down. Acceptance: KPI card displays repeat gifter rate with drill-down list.

title: Week 6 retention scorecard
description: Publish weekly retention scorecard with core loop deltas. Acceptance: Scorecard includes AFRG, repeat gifter rate, and time-to-first-gift deltas.
